column2: a young man in his twenties in a wrinkled hoodie, sitting on the floor hunched over a laptop balanced on a cardboard box, an empty pizza box and crumpled cans beside him, staring blankly up at the camera with dead tired eyes
an older man in his sixties in a tweed blazer and glasses, lowering a big open newspaper held in both hands to stare at the camera in total shock, eyebrows shot up

a man in his thirties with slicked back hair and rolled up shirt sleeves under suspenders, leaning over a desk covered in printed bar charts, jabbing one finger down at a chart, an intense excited grin
a young woman in a cozy oversized knit sweater curled up in a big armchair with a laptop on her knees, eating popcorn from a bowl, completely relaxed, smirking at the laptop screen

a man in his forties in a shiny tracksuit with a whistle around his neck like a sports coach, holding two fingers up toward the camera with one hand and a stopwatch in the other, shouting with intense motivational energy
a man in a 1990s tuxedo with a loosened bow tie at a card table, pushing two tall stacks of plain poker chips forward with both hands, a confident all-in grin
a young woman in her twenties in a denim jacket, sitting on the edge of a desk next to an old laptop, holding a coffee mug in both hands, a calm confident smile at the camera
